class.name: CursorSet
class.brief_description: A collection of custom mouse cursor textures and hotspots.
class.description: Stores a [Texture2D] and a hotspot for each shape in [enum Input.CursorShape]. Assign a resource file to [member ProjectSettings.display/user_interface/cursor/default_cursor_set] to apply it at startup, or call [method apply] to switch cursor sets at runtime. Each texture must have dimensions between 1 and 256 pixels. Sizes up to 128×128 are recommended for platform compatibility. Hotspots are measured in pixels from the texture's top-left corner and must be inside the texture. A missing texture restores the system cursor for that shape when the set is applied. Changing this resource does not update active cursors automatically. Call [method apply] after editing it. As with [method Input.set_custom_mouse_cursor], applying a set has no effect in the editor.

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies all cursor textures and hotspots using [method Input.set_custom_mouse_cursor]. Shapes with no texture reset to the system cursor, including shapes customized by a previously applied set. Invalid texture sizes or hotspots report an error and leave that shape unchanged.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the texture for [param shape], or [code]null[/code] if the shape uses the system cursor.

method.name: set_hotspot
method.description: Sets the hotspot for [param shape]. The hotspot must be finite and non-negative. When applied, it must be inside the assigned texture.

method.name: set_texture
method.description: Sets the texture for [param shape]. Pass [code]null[/code] to use the system cursor when applied.
